turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My cat keeps scratching the couch. It's shredded on one side.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Poor couch. Does she have a scratching post?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A little one, she ignores it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then try either a tall sturdy post right by the couch, or a flat cardboard scratcher. Which do you think she'd like?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey, can you stay quiet for a minute? I need to talk to my partner. I'll come back to you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Chloe, did you ever finish that mystery I lent you?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Last night! I stayed up way too late.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did you guess who did it?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Not even close. I was sure it was the sister.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Everyone thinks that. Can I have it back? My mom wants to read it.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's on my nightstand. I'll bring it down.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, I'm back now. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. Still thinking about how to save that couch?
